If your claim is approved, yes. The policy says we send **one** free replacement of the **same plant**. If the bird of paradise is out of stock, you'd get **store credit** instead. You wouldn't need to send the damaged plant back.

I can't promise approval, because a Plant Care Specialist has to review your photos first. The policy covers losing more than a third of the leaves as significant decline, and you've described losing about half. That is the kind of case the guarantee is meant for. One exception is damage from pets, pests introduced after delivery or deliberate neglect, which isn't covered. If you repotted into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days, that is also excluded.

A replacement gets its own new **30-day guarantee**, so if it fails you can claim once more.

Since this is your third time chasing, I'm escalating it to a Support Lead. To pass it on, I still need your **order number** and whether the claim shows as submitted in "My Orders" (and roughly what date you filed it). Would you also like the one-time **$15** goodwill store credit added for the delay?
